text.p: The former chief executive of Centennial Technologies Inc. was arraigned in U.S. District Court here Friday, according to the U.S. Attorney's office.
Emanual Pinez was arrested Thursday night, the office said.
Other details, including the charges against Pinez, were not immediately known.
Officials at Centennial, which provides contract manufacturing services, were not immediately available for comment.

On Tuesday, Centennial said it fired Pinez, removed its chief financial officer, James Murphy, and launched an inquiry into the accuracy of its most recently reported earnings and prior financial statements.
The Billerica, Mass.-based company faces several class-action lawsuits.
Centennial shares last traded on Feb. 10 at $16.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
